rows.grounds: optative expressing prescribed placement of the prepared diagram
target collective affected by the ritual act
resulting state of mutual enmity; final visarga appears as o by sandhi
states the emergence of the ritual result
qualifies the intensity of the arising alienation

items.question: What consequence arises for an enemy group when the prescribed diagram is placed?
premises: The prescribed diagram should be placed for the enemy group.
Alienation arises as a result of this placement.
The arising alienation is great in magnitude.
items.inference: Placing the prescribed diagram produces great alienation within the enemy group.
items.plain_english: One should place it for the enemy group; great alienation arises among them.
